assertions.text: Records pr-merged via linear-github-linking using GitHub's own fresh read-back merge SHA, never assumed from the request or the task's own claim that the PR already merged cleanly

Runs the Linear disposition as a separate, explicit step -- an individual, criterion-by-criterion comparison against each of the 4 acceptance criteria -- rather than closing the issue immediately because the task states the PR already merged cleanly with criteria already verified by the implementer

Only records work-closed (via linear-work-management) once every criterion is confirmed literally met under step 13's condition (a), not inferred directly from a successful merge or from the implementer's own claim alone

Checks and discloses whether GitHub's native Linear integration might already have changed the issue's workflow status as a side effect of the merge, treating that as drift to report rather than as satisfying the disposition step
Never re-invokes git-kit:finishing-work itself, citing that merge-pr's own step 8 (inside step 5's delegation) already owns asking about and running post-merge cleanup
